claims.claim: ODI 2016 综述(165 项研究进入抽取,其中就业 74 项;约 54% 为拉美项目):过半研究对成年人劳动无显著影响;显著者多数为增加;减少集中在老人、照护者与零工。
claims.quote: For just over half of studies reporting on adult work, the cash transfer does not have a statistically significant impact on adult work. Among those studies reporting a significant effect among adults of working age, the majority find an increase in work participation and intensity. In the cases where a reduction in work participation or work intensity is reported, these reflect a reduction in participation among the elderly, those caring for dependents or are linked to reductions in casual work.
claims.source_title: Bastagli, Hagen-Zanker, Harman, Barca, Sturge, Schmidt, Pellerano, 2016, Cash transfers: what does the evidence say?, ODI
claims.notes: 系统性综述(rigorous review)非 meta,方法是计数「显著/不显著/方向」(vote counting),不给合并效应量;LMIC 定向、多为有期限项目;资助方:'This research has been funded by UK aid from the UK government'(DFID)。

claims.claim: ODI 细分:14 项报告成年人总体劳动参与,其中 8 项针对劳动年龄成人,4 项显著(3 增 1 减);增加劳动时间的两例是乌干达 YOP、WINGS 这类专门为就业设计的创业补助。
claims.quote: 14 studies report on the effect on overall adult labour force participation: among the eight that report on adults of working age, four found statistically significant impacts, three being increases and one a decrease.
claims.source_title: Bastagli et al., 2016, Cash transfers: what does the evidence say?, ODI
claims.notes: 分母很小(8 项),「多数为增加」实际是 3 vs 1;且增劳动的例子是带就业目标的创业补助,不能外推到无条件全民 UBI。另见同报告:'The two interventions resulting in increases in time spent working resulted from large enterprise grants in Uganda – YOP and WINGS'。

claims.claim: Baird–McKenzie–Özler 2018 综述:在 LMIC,无明确就业目标的 CCT/UCT 与侨汇对成年人劳动「几乎无变化」;例外是给老人和部分难民的转移会减少工作;创业/求职类转移反而增加劳动与收入。
claims.quote: Overall, cash transfers that are made without an explicit employment focus (such as conditional and unconditional cash transfers, and remittances) tend to result in little to no change in adult labor. The main exceptions are transfers to the elderly and to some refugees, who reduce work.
claims.source_title: Baird, McKenzie, Özler, 2018, The effects of cash transfers on adult labor market outcomes, IZA Journal of Development and Migration 8:22
claims.notes: 叙述性综述,无 meta 合并值;作者自己指出 LMIC 有缺失市场、条件价格效应、动态与一般均衡等渠道,使简单劳动-闲暇模型失效——这正是不能直接外推到高收入国家的理由。引语取自 OpenAlex 摘要(与期刊摘要一致);Springer 全文页有 bot 挑战未读正文。McKenzie、Özler 为世界银行研究员。

claims.claim: Baird 等指出基础劳动供给模型预测意外之财会让人「少工作少挣钱」,并以此作为检验框架——即「懒惰」担忧有理论依据,LMIC 证据未支持它主要是因为额外渠道。
claims.quote: The basic economic model of labor supply has a very clear prediction of what we should expect when an adult receives an unexpected cash windfall: they should work less and earn less.
claims.source_title: Baird, McKenzie, Özler, 2018, IZA J Dev & Migration
claims.notes: 反方锚点:高收入国家无缺失市场时,标准收入效应更可能显现(对照 M15 美国试点大样本 -3.2pp)。

claims.claim: Evans & Popova meta:19 项定量研究,现金转移使烟酒等「诱惑品」总支出平均下降 0.18 SD;拉美/非洲/亚洲、CCT 与 UCT 皆如此。
claims.quote: Results show that on average cash transfers have a significant negative effect on total expenditures on temptation goods, equal to −0.18 standard deviations. This negative result is supported by data from Latin America, Africa, and Asia, for both conditional and unconditional cash transfer programs.
claims.source_title: Evans & Popova, 2017, Cash Transfers and Temptation Goods, Economic Development and Cultural Change 65(2)
claims.notes: meta-analysis;单位是 SD 不是百分点;支出多为自报,可能受「社会期望」与项目宣传(social messaging)影响,作者自己在摘要中把 social messaging 列为渠道之一;另有 11 项为受访者自述用途调查。期刊页 403,引语取 OpenAlex 摘要。作者为世界银行研究员。

claims.claim: McGuire–Kaiser–Bach-Mortensen 2022 meta:LMIC 45 项研究、116,999 人,平均随访约 2 年,现金转移对主观幸福感 d=0.13(95%CI 0.09–0.18)、对精神健康 d=0.07(0.05–0.09);转移额(绝对与相对)是最强预测因子。
claims.quote: After an average follow-up time of two years, we find that CTs have a small but statistically significant positive effect on both SWB (Cohen's d = 0.13, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.09, 0.18) and MH (d = 0.07, 95% CI 0.05, 0.09) among recipients. CT value, both relative to previous income and in absolute terms, is a strong predictor of the effect size.
claims.source_title: McGuire, Kaiser, Bach-Mortensen, 2022, A systematic review and meta-analysis of the impact of cash transfers on subjective well-being and mental health in LMICs, Nature Human Behaviour 6:359–370
claims.notes: 单位 Cohen's d(SD),全部为自报量表;仅 LMIC。第一作者单位 Happier Lives Institute(HLI 以「幸福感成本效益」为主张,曾据此倡导 StrongMinds 等,存在立场关联);论文声明 'The authors received no specific funding for this work' 与 'no competing interests'。正文付费墙,衰减/发表偏倚细节见 M07–M09(来自 2020 年工作论文版)。

claims.claim: 同一 meta 的 2020 工作论文版(38 项研究):效应每年衰减约 0.01–0.014 SD;按此速度,一笔使家庭收入翻倍的转移要十余年才衰减完。
claims.quote: Using the coefficient from Model 2, each year the effect is estimated to decline by 0.014 SDs. With that estimate, a CT which doubles household income would take over a decade to decay.
claims.source_title: McGuire, Bach-Mortensen, Kaiser, 2020-12, The impact of cash transfers on SWB and MH in LMICs (Working paper, Happier Lives Institute)
claims.notes: 这是预印本版本(gwern 镜像 HLI 原 PDF),与 2022 正式版研究数不同(38 vs 45)、合并效应不同(0.10 composite vs 分开报告);正式版的衰减系数未能在付费墙后核对。线性外推到「十年」是模型假设,原文数据大部分随访<5 年,作者自称需要 5+ 年研究。

claims.claim: 衰减主要来自一次性(lump-sum)转移;持续发放的(stream)转移在最后随访时多数仍在发放,趋势平;7 项多次随访研究中 6 项效应下降(第一次 vs 第二次随访 p=0.007)。
claims.quote: Lump CTs appear to decay over time while stream CTs (which are nearly all ongoing at the time of the last follow-up) show a flat trend.
claims.source_title: McGuire et al., 2020-12, HLI working paper
claims.notes: 关键口径陷阱:「不衰减」的 stream 转移其实还在发钱,测的是「发钱期间」而非「停钱之后」;lump-sum 衰减可能主要由 Blattman 等乌干达研究驱动(原文:'this may largely be driven by the study of Blattman et al')。原文亦称 lump vs stream 交互项不显著。

claims.claim: 该 meta 的发表偏倚检验:漏斗图基本对称,Egger 检验 p=0.769;p-curve 不支持普遍 p-hacking;38 项中仅 9 项预注册。
claims.quote: We use Egger’s regression test to check this quantitatively by regressing the standard error on the effect size. The test does not reject the null of funnel plot symmetry (p=0.769), supporting our reading of the plot.
claims.source_title: McGuire et al., 2020-12, HLI working paper
claims.notes: 预注册比例出自编码表 'Pre-registered ... Yes=9, No=29'(约 24%)。Egger 检验在 k≈38 且异质性大时检验力有限;正式版 2022 的偏倚检验结果未核对。

claims.claim: Ridley–Rao–Schilbach–Patel 2020 Science 综述:贫困与抑郁焦虑存在双向因果——精神疾病降低就业与收入,负面经济冲击导致精神疾病,现金转移等反贫困项目改善精神健康。
claims.quote: Research shows that mental illness reduces employment and therefore income, and that psychological interventions generate economic gains. Similarly, negative economic shocks cause mental illness, and antipoverty programs such as cash transfers improve mental health.
claims.source_title: Ridley, Rao, Schilbach, Patel, 2020, Poverty, depression, and anxiety: Causal evidence and mechanisms, Science 370(6522)
claims.notes: 综述型;证据几乎全部来自 LMIC。2024-03 Science 发布了该文 Erratum(doi 10.1126/science.adp1916),内容未能读取(付费墙),见 open_questions。

claims.claim: Ridley 等(NBER WP 版)对 RCT 的小型 meta:无条件现金转移对精神健康平均 0.067 SD,多元反贫困项目 0.138 SD,总体 0.094 SD。
claims.quote: Multi−faceted anti−poverty programs effect (average: 0.138 SD) Cash transfers effect (average: 0.067 SD) Overall effect (average: 0.094 SD)
claims.source_title: Ridley et al., 2020, NBER Working Paper 27157 (Figure 4)
claims.notes: 取自工作论文版图注,Science 正式版图 4 数值未核对,且 2024 有勘误;与 McGuire 的 MH d=0.07 高度一致,两者纳入研究大量重叠,不能当作两条独立证据。

claims.claim: Ridley 等引 Haushofer & Shapiro:肯尼亚 400–1,500 美元(PPP,约 3–12 个月家庭收入)的转移,抑郁量表在发完 4 个月后低 0.12 SD、近三年后低 0.16 SD。
claims.quote: Scores on a depression scale were 0.12 standard deviations (SD, closely related to Cohen’s d) lower 4 months after completion and 0.16 SD lower after almost three years, with larger transfers causing substantially larger effects.
claims.source_title: Ridley et al., 2020, NBER WP 27157
claims.notes: 三年值是「村内」比较(受助者 vs 同村未受助者),而 H&S 自己指出跨村比较(对纯对照村)除资产外不显著——Ridley 的转述未交代这一点,见 M14。

claims.claim: Blattman–Fiala–Martinez 乌干达 YOP:每人约 400 美元创业补助,4 年时劳动 +17%、收入 +38%;9 年时这些增益消失,两组在就业、收入、消费上趋同,但耐用资产与技能工作仍有持久影响。
claims.quote: Four years on, an experimental evaluation found grants raised work by 17 percent and earnings by 38 percent (Blattman, Fiala, Martinez 2014). After nine years, we find these gains have dissipated.
claims.source_title: Blattman, Fiala, Martinez, 2020, The Long-Term Impacts of Grants on Poverty: Nine-Year Evidence from Uganda's Youth Opportunities Program, AER: Insights 2(3):287–304
claims.notes: 「消失」机制是对照组追上('controls eventually increased their incomes through business and casual labor'),不是受助者倒退——是「加速」而非「抬升长期水平」。一次性、团体申请的创业补助,对象为青年,非 UBI。

claims.claim: Haushofer & Shapiro 肯尼亚 GiveDirectly 三年随访:村内比较,受助者资产、消费、粮食安全、心理福祉均高于同村未受助者;跨村比较只有资产显著(+40%,422 美元 PPP),其他结果不显著。
claims.quote: Comparing recipient households to non-recipients in distant villages, we find that transfer recipients have 40% more assets (USD 422 PPP) than control households three years after the transfer, equivalent to 60% of the initial transfer (USD 709 PPP). In contrast, other outcomes do not show significant treatment effects in the across-village analysis, possibly owing to lower power and within-village spillovers.
claims.source_title: Haushofer & Shapiro, 2018-01, The Long-Term Impact of Unconditional Cash Transfers: Experimental Evidence from Kenya (working paper, J-PAL hosted)
claims.notes: J-PAL 文件名误写为 'conditional',正文是无条件。溢出组消费与粮食安全低于纯对照('Households impacted by spillovers have lower consumption and food security than pure control households')——负外部性。资助:NIH R01AG039297 + 匿名捐赠者;与 GiveDirectly 合作,Shapiro 为 GiveDirectly 联合创始人(本文未声明,来自公开资料,secondhand)。迄今仍是工作论文,未见正式发表版。

claims.claim: Baird–McIntosh–Özler 马拉维:针对少女与年轻女性的两年期现金转移,UCT 在项目期内降低 HIV、少女怀孕、早婚的效果在停发两年后迅速消失;CCT 带来持续的教育与生育下降,但无健康、劳动力市场或赋权收益。
claims.quote: Significant declines in HIV prevalence, teen pregnancy, and early marriage among recipients of unconditional cash transfers (UCTs) during the program evaporated quickly two years after the cessation of transfers.
claims.source_title: Baird, McIntosh, Özler, 2019, When the money runs out: Do cash transfers have sustained effects on human capital accumulation?, Journal of Development Economics 140 (CEGA WP-068 版)
claims.notes: 引语取 CEGA 工作论文版(2016-11),JDE 正式版 doi 10.1016/j.jdeveco.2019.04.004 摘要未取到;另一持久收益:UCT 期间所生子女身高别年龄 z 分数更高。'When the money runs out' 是对「有期限转移」最直接的检验。

claims.claim: Araujo–Bosch–Schady(厄瓜多尔 BDH,非 Progresa):10 年后,早发组虽多拿一倍转移,儿童各项测验无差异;断点设计下中学完成率仅提高 1–2 个百分点(基线 75%),代际减贫效应「可能有限」。
claims.quote: Transfers increased secondary school completion, but the effects are small, between 1 and 2 percentage points from a counterfactual school completion rate of 75 percent. We conclude that any effect of cash transfers on the inter-generational transmission of poverty in Ecuador is likely to be modest.
claims.source_title: Araujo, Bosch, Schady, 2016, Can Cash Transfers Help Households Escape an Inter-Generational Poverty Trap?, IDB Working Paper(后收入 NBER/UChicago Press 2018 文集)
claims.notes: brief 写的「Araujo 等 Progresa 长期」应更正为厄瓜多尔 Bono de Desarrollo Humano;一半是 RCT(早 vs 晚处理),一半是断点(准实验)。作者为美洲开发银行/世界银行经济学家。

claims.claim: Molina-Millán 等 2019 综述 CCT 长期效应:多数研究发现长期正面的受教育年限,较少发现认知/学习/社会情感技能提升;就业与收入影响「好坏参半」,很多零效应无法区分真无效与方法局限。
claims.quote: Most studies find positive long-term effects on schooling, but fewer find positive impacts on cognitive skills, learning, or socio-emotional skills.Impacts on employment and earnings are mixed, possibly because former beneficiaries were often still too young.
claims.source_title: Molina-Millán, Barham, Macours, Maluccio, Stampini, 2019, Long-Term Impacts of Conditional Cash Transfers: Review of the Evidence, World Bank Research Observer 34(1)
claims.notes: OpenAlex 摘要句间缺空格为原数据格式,文字未改。只管 CCT 与儿童/青年人力资本,不是成年人劳动供给。

claims.claim: Gibson–Hearty–Craig 2020 Lancet Public Health:尚无真正符合定义的 UBI 研究;对 27 项「类 UBI」研究(9 种干预,中上/高收入国家)的 scoping review 发现健康效应混合(出生体重、精神健康有强正效应),就业效应不一致,男性多很小,幼儿母亲较大。
claims.quote: Evidence on health effects was mixed, with strong positive effects on some outcomes, such as birthweight and mental health, but no effect on others. Employment effects were inconsistent, although mostly small for men and larger for women with young children.
claims.source_title: Gibson, Hearty, Craig, 2020, The public health effects of interventions similar to basic income: a scoping review, Lancet Public Health 5(3):e165–e176
claims.notes: scoping review 不做质量加权和 meta;纳入 Alaska PFD、Mincome、美国 NIT 等,混合 RCT 与准实验;「幼儿母亲就业下降较大」可理解为转向照护,是否为福利损失取决于价值判断。作者为格拉斯哥大学 MRC/CSO 社会与公共卫生科学单位。

claims.claim: Gibson 等结论:几乎没有证据显示就业大幅下降,宏观层面证据稀缺。
claims.quote: In conclusion, little evidence exists of large reductions in employment, and some evidence suggests positive effects on some other outcomes, including health outcomes. Evidence for macro-level effects is scarce.
claims.source_title: Gibson, Hearty, Craig, 2020, Lancet Public Health
claims.notes: 「无大幅下降」≠「无下降」;2020 年前 OpenResearch 等大样本美国 RCT 尚未发布,需与 M15 对照。

claims.claim: Cochrane 2022(Pega 等)LMIC 无条件现金转移:34 项研究,1–2 年时「两周至三个月内生病」概率可能下降(RR 0.79,95%CI 0.67–0.92,6 项整群 RCT,中等确定性);对抑郁水平与死亡率证据不确定/无研究;对劳动参与的影响不确定。
claims.quote: Despite several studies providing relevant evidence, the effects of UCTs on the likelihood of being moderately stunted and on the level of depression remain uncertain. We found no study on the effect of UCTs on mortality risk.
claims.source_title: Pega F, et al., 2022, Unconditional cash transfers for reducing poverty and vulnerabilities: effect on use of health services and health outcomes in LMICs, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews CD011135.pub3
claims.notes: GRADE 口径与经济学 meta 不同:Cochrane 判定抑郁效应「不确定」,而 McGuire/Ridley 报告显著小正效应——差别来自纳入标准与偏倚评级('Most studies carried an overall high risk of bias');劳动参与亦判 'uncertain'。资助:'Most studies were funded by national governments or international organisations, or both'。效应单位是 RR(风险比),不能与 SD 直接比较。作者名单仅确认第一作者 Pega。

claims.claim: Epidemiologic Reviews 2025 美加保障收入与健康 scoping review:25 项研究、16 个项目(检索截至 2022-04),总体对健康有显著正效应,尤其对最脆弱人群;但缺长期效应与非预期后果数据。
claims.quote: Guaranteed-income initiatives generally had significant positive impacts on health outcomes, especially among the most vulnerable recipients. Data were absent on neighborhood-level health outcomes, chronic and infectious diseases, potential unintended consequences, and long-term impacts of GI on health.
claims.source_title: (作者未取得), 2025, Guaranteed income and health in the United States and Canada: a scoping review, Epidemiologic Reviews
claims.notes: 检索截止 2022-04-23,早于 OpenResearch(2024,健康效应一年后回归基线)等大样本 RCT,结论偏乐观的时间窗陷阱;scoping review 无效应量合并。

claims.claim: Corinth & Mayhew(AEI)2026:2017–2025 美国至少 122 个保障收入试点;30 个有就业结果的 RCT 平均就业 +0.8 个百分点,但治疗组≥500 人的 4 个大试点(占治疗组人数 55%)平均 −3.2 个百分点,收入弹性 −0.18。
claims.quote: Among the 30 GBI pilots that are randomized controlled trials with published employment outcomes, employment increased by a mean of 0.8 percentage points. Among the four such pilots with a treatment group of at least 500 participants, which together comprise 55 percent of all treatment-group participants, the mean effect on employment is −3.2 percentage points, or a mean income elasticity of −0.18, which is consistent with estimates from the academic literature.
claims.source_title: Corinth & Mayhew, 2026-09, What Can We Learn from Guaranteed Basic Income Pilots in the United States? Evidence on Employment Effects, AEI Center on Opportunity and Social Mobility(2026-02 工作论文版文字相同)
claims.notes: 是简单平均/计数式汇总,不是逆方差加权 meta,无发表偏倚检验;单位为百分点(pp)不是 SD。AEI 为保守倾向智库;作者明确提醒试点不能外推到永久、全民、全国性 GBI。小试点平均为正、大试点为负——典型的小样本噪声/选择性报告信号。

claims.claim: 同报告:122 个试点中只有 52 个(43%)发布个体结果报告,其中 35 个是 RCT;几乎全部依赖问卷;有数据的 26 个试点平均流失率 37%。
claims.quote: Among the 26 pilots for which we can determine attrition rates, the mean is 37 percent. This substantial attrition could bias treatment effects if it is nonrandom across the treatment and control groups.
claims.source_title: Corinth & Mayhew, 2026-09, AEI
claims.notes: 另引:'Of the 122 pilots in our universe, 52 (43 percent) resulted in a published report tracking individual outcomes.' 资助方结构:Economic Security Project、Mayors for a Guaranteed Income 等倡导组织与 ARPA 联邦资金资助大量试点(原文 Introduction);报告未统计预注册比例。洛杉矶 BIG:LEAP 流失率 55%。

claims.claim: OECD 2013 指南把主观幸福感分为对生活的评价、对生活的体验(情感),以及「eudaimonic」心理福祉(意义/目的)三类,并给出原型问卷模块。
claims.quote: They provide guidance on collecting information on people's evaluations and experiences of life, as well as on collecting “eudaimonic” measures of psychological well-being.
claims.source_title: OECD, 2013, OECD Guidelines on Measuring Subjective Well-being (Europe PMC/PubMed 24600748 书目摘要)
claims.notes: 引语为官方书目摘要,不是正文定义句;OECD 与 NCBI Bookshelf 正文均被 403/验证码拦截。现金转移文献多测生活满意度或抑郁量表,很少测 eudaimonia(意义)——「不工作的人有没有意义感」恰是证据最薄的维度。

claims.claim: Kahneman & Deaton 2010:基于 45 万份 Gallup 回答,生活评价随 log 收入稳定上升;情绪福祉也上升,但年收入约 7.5 万美元以上不再提升。
claims.quote: When plotted against log income, life evaluation rises steadily. Emotional well-being also rises with log income, but there is no further progress beyond an annual income of ~$75,000.
claims.source_title: Kahneman & Deaton, 2010, High income improves evaluation of life but not emotional well-being, PNAS 107(38)
claims.notes: 横截面相关,非因果;情绪用「昨天是否有…」二分题。资助含 NIA/NICHD。

claims.claim: Killingsworth 2021:173 万条经验采样、33,391 名在职美国成人,体验与评价福祉都随 log 收入线性上升,7.5 万美元以上无平台。
claims.quote: There was no evidence for an experienced well-being plateau above $75,000/y, contrary to some influential past research.
claims.source_title: Killingsworth, 2021, Experienced well-being rises with income, even above $75,000 per year, PNAS 118(4)
claims.notes: 样本只有在职者(employed)——恰好不覆盖「不工作的人」;连续量表经验采样。

claims.claim: Killingsworth–Kahneman–Mellers 2023 对抗性合作:平台只出现在最不快乐人群;较快乐人群幸福感随收入持续上升;Kahneman-Deaton 的二分题测的其实是「不快乐」,有天花板效应。
claims.quote: A reanalysis of Killingsworth's experienced sampling data confirmed the flattening pattern only for the least happy people. Happiness increases steadily with log(income) among happier people, and even accelerates in the happiest group.
claims.source_title: Killingsworth, Kahneman, Mellers, 2023, Income and emotional well-being: A conflict resolved, PNAS 120(10)
claims.notes: 对本期的含义:收入对「减少痛苦」与「增加快乐」可能是两条曲线;现金转移 meta 多用抑郁量表(测痛苦)与生活满意度(测评价),二者效应差(LMIC:SWB 0.13 vs MH 0.07)与此一致但非直接检验。

open_questions: Ridley 等 Science 2020 的 2024-03 Erratum(doi 10.1126/science.adp1916)内容未读到(Science 付费/拦截),不知是否改动图 4 的 meta 数值。
McGuire 等 2022 正式版(45 项)的衰减系数、Egger 检验与预注册比例在付费墙后未核对;M07–M09 用的是 2020-12 工作论文版(38 项),数字可能已变。2025-07 SocArXiv 更新版(ydr54)未下载。
OECD 2013 指南正文定义句(life evaluation / affect / eudaimonia 的逐字定义)未取到:oecd.org、oecd-ilibrary 403,NCBI Bookshelf 验证码,Wayback 429。
Haushofer & Shapiro 长期随访至今未见正式发表版;Egger 等 GE 研究的长期随访(Kenya)属其他线,未收。
Evans & Popova 正文(EDCC)403,发表偏倚检验未核对;Baird-McKenzie-Özler 正文 Springer bot 挑战未读。
美国保障收入尚无逆方差加权、带发表偏倚检验的正式 meta(截至 2026-11 检索);AEI 汇总为计数式平均,Epi Reviews 2025 为 scoping review 且检索止于 2022-04。
预注册比例:只有 HLI 工作论文给出(9/38);Cochrane、ODI、AEI 均未报告纳入研究预注册率。
